baslik: The Helium Airship Torn Apart by a Storm

sahneler.metin: The US Navy airship Shenandoah was caught in a storm over Ohio.
It was torn into pieces, and fourteen men were killed.
Being filled with helium, it didn't catch fire.
A violent updraft carried it upward.
As it climbed, its gas cells expanded.
Some valves had been removed to save scarce helium.
The frame was overstressed and broke apart.
Later airships were built stronger and routed away from storms.

aciklama:
USS Shenandoah broke apart in a storm over Ohio. The cause: structural overload from storm-driven climb, with gas valves reduced to conserve helium.

#shorts #engineering #aviation
